Tip #1: Use 1 Piece of Magic Armour

RuneScape Dragonwilds combat can be a lot easier once you understand the mechanics the game doesn't always explain.

In this Dragonwilds combat guide, I'm covering 10 combat tips that can make a huge difference - from using mixed armour sets and managing stamina, to parrying, enemy weaknesses, food buffs, spells, special attacks and weapon buffs.

These are especially useful as you progress into the later regions and start taking on harder enemies and Hard Mode.

In this video:

comments.text: Grab crossbow that shoots bones. Use the button on the left side of your mouse that clicks when you press it. Ignore every combat mechanic in the game and beat everything in the game. (Any ranged weapon can take advantage of this method. The bone xbow just has easiest projectiles to make and lowest repair cost). Dragonwilds has the worst combat of any game I've ever played bc it is way too easy. Almost every enemy encounter can just be skipped by walking by it and the things you do have to fight are so slow with insanely obvious attacks that can be dodged with zero skill. Thb combat in this game is super disappointing even bosses are a total joke. Its bad when the environments are scarier then any enemy in the game.

comments.text: The animation locks are almost game breaking. I've never been so frustrated with any game's combat as this one. It's truly asinine. There's no cancel attack feature, and the 4th attack is such a stupidly long animation, THAT CAN'T BE CANCELED makes me want to quit the game forever.
